title: Vectors and geometry
learner: Returning learners who remember coordinate arithmetic and basic trigonometry but need to recover geometric meaning and reliable signed vector calculations.
assumedKnowledge: F04 standard-angle trigonometry and inverse-angle quadrant checks

include: Vector arithmetic, resultants, and coordinate directions
exclude: A full linear algebra or multivariable calculus course
General basis matrices, eigenvectors, vector fields, differential operators, Jacobians
Physical dynamics derivations beyond supplied constant-force/torque relationships

routes.quick: Five diagnostic probes route to specific lessons. Use Quick recall and independent lesson checkpoints before the four-question mixed recall.
routes.full: Work components, arithmetic and directions, dot products and projections, ordered cross products, then lines/planes and coordinate systems. Predict in each activity, explain differences, and save reasoning in notes.

escalation.text: Use the linked free OpenStax Calculus Volume 3 sections for first-time instruction. CEE 300 and the full physics courses are the corresponding course destinations; their vector learning packs are not yet authored in this baseline. F03 and F04 provide available coordinate and trigonometry support.

overlap: MTH 215 b05/F03 cover coordinates, signed changes, and distances in simple graphs.
MTH 215 b06/F04 cover right triangles, exact standard angles, and quadrant-aware direction.
F06 supplies unit conversion and dimensional checks for work and torque.
reuse.implementation: Reuse exact/rational graders, F04 trigValue and standard-angle conventions, and existing progress/notes/backup. New vector questions retain F07 identities; source lessons and attempts remain unchanged.

assessment.checkpoints: Four critical questions per lesson; multiple fields cover each objective within the existing eight-field limit.
assessment.mixed: Four checks: a multipart components/arithmetic question with p1/p2 routes, then dot/projection, cross/area, and geometry/coordinates. Independent lesson checkpoints provide fuller coverage.
assessment.evidence: Visits, confidence, diagnostic, guided work, and activities do not establish objective evidence. F07 checkpoints and mixed recall use separate versioned evidence.

sharedCapabilities.interface: Lesson.interaction adds { kind: 'refresher-vector-lab', mode: 'components' | 'addition' | 'dot' | 'cross' | 'coordinates', prompt: string }.
sharedCapabilities.integration: One strict union member and reader dispatch; new scoped modules render keyboard inputs, existing question fields, SVG diagrams, and equivalent tables. No storage, grading, backup, or app-shell redesign.

verification: Independently check endpoints, norms, normalization, vector sums, scaling, equilibrants, quadrants, and exact trig component identities over at least 100 seeds per structure.
Check dot/angle/projection through symmetry, orthogonal residuals, Cauchy-Schwarz and explicit zero guards; check cross through determinant oracle, antisymmetry and perpendicularity.
Check area with planar determinants; torque order and units; line membership by all shared-parameter equations; plane residual/distance and coordinate round trips.
Test equivalent exact radicals/fractions, numeric angle tolerance, invalid expressions, zero direction, parallel inputs, pole/origin coordinate ambiguity, and all KaTeX rendering.
Verify all guided activities, independent checkpoints, mixed recall routing, notes, exact resume, backup, keyboard/mobile/Axe; run full tests, lint, typecheck, build.
Mark preview only after verification, with independent human review pending. Finish F07 before detailed planning of F08.
